verdict.rationale: smolagents provides sandboxed execution via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker, and lets developers restrict allowed imports via additional_authorized_imports plus a hardened LocalPythonExecutor, giving some fine-grained control over what code-execution agents can do; final_answer_checks also allow validation gating. However, there is no explicit fine-grained per-tool permission system (e.g., role-based access control on individual tools) and community evidence shows the import-restriction guardrail can break legitimate workflows (matplotlib blocked), indicating rough edges. missing for 10: dedicated per-tool permission/ACL system, independent security audit or hands-on validation of sandbox isolation, clearer docs on combining sandboxing with tool-level restrictions.
